atoms.name: Programmed I/O and polling
atoms.one_line: The CPU loops on a status bit; cost = polls per second x time per poll, paid whether or not events happen.

atoms.name: Interrupts: sequence, vectors, priority
atoms.one_line: Finish instruction, save PC, load ISR address, run, restore. Vectored skips polling; daisy chain orders priority by position.

atoms.name: DMA modes and setup
atoms.one_line: DMA controller becomes bus master; burst holds the bus for a block, cycle stealing takes one cycle per word; count register limits one transfer.

atoms.name: Cycle-stealing transfer rate
atoms.one_line: Rate = clock x stolen fraction x bits per cycle; time stolen = words per second x memory cycle.

atoms.name: CPU overhead: polling, interrupt, DMA
atoms.one_line: Compare CPU time per event or per byte; DMA pays only setup and completion.

atoms.name: Disk access time
atoms.one_line: Seek + average rotational latency (half a rotation) + transfer (rotation / sectors per track).
